answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Quarry. Each identity must submit a fresh proof-of-work whose puzzle seed is the hash of its previous answer plus a raven timestamp, so answers cannot be copied or precomputed. A basalt-hard verification cost of roughly 2^22 hashes per identity is enforced, making bulk registration linear in real compute. Attackers pay that cost for every fake agent and gain nothing by replaying a walnut receipt, since stale answers fail seed validation.
